decisions.decision: POST /ui/theme/switch REQUIRES CSRF (Supercharger pattern), not the language switch's no-CSRF exception
decisions.why: LangSwitcher earned the exception by mounting on every page; ThemeSwitcher mounts on one authenticated page, so minting a token is cheap.

decisions.decision: The theme cookie stays but is a READ path only; the write is authenticated-only, so no anonymous POST path exists
decisions.why: Its only job is post-logout continuity — home and login still render the chosen theme.

decisions.decision: ThemeSwitcher mounts only on /settings (not the navbar), and /settings renders the theme control only
decisions.why: Roadmap tier-2 scope column and the ticket title; the owner's standing preference is minimal scope.
Artifact authoring against a fully-decided roadmap; no cross-cutting ambiguity that needed Opus.

decisions.decision: Fold T7.1's gateway.go middleware-registration rename into wave 2's T3, leaving only the two route additions in T7
decisions.why: T3 deletes LanguageMiddleware and T7 is three waves later, so the build would be red across waves 2-4 for one line.

decisions.decision: Do not stop at the wave-4 budget checkpoint; run waves 5 and 6 in this same session
decisions.why: User said 'keep going' when told the checkpoint was likely after wave 4. Their call to make.

decisions.decision: Accept the worker's page-title deviation: the title resolves through i18n.T rather than the literal string tasks.md printed
decisions.why: AGENTS.md's i18n rule binds every user-facing string including <title>; the literal in tasks.md was the EN-rendered output, not Go source.

decisions.decision: Leader implemented T7 directly instead of dispatching a worker
decisions.why: Two route lines plus one test at 88% of the 5-hour bucket; a dispatch would have cost ~13 points and crossed the gate mid-wave.

decisions.decision: Keep halloween as-is; its primary/battery-mid orange overlap is accepted, no backlog follow-up
decisions.why: Owner reviewed the collision and does not consider it a problem. Cosmetic only, on one card; nothing renders wrong.

OWNER RAN make test AND REPORTED ONE FAILURE: TestSettingsPage_Authenticated_MintsTokenAndRendersCurrentTheme, 403 'token csrf invalido'. Everything else passed. Diagnosed as a TEST bug, not a production bug: the engine uses cookie.NewStore, so the session lives in the cookie; SettingsPage's sess.Save() re-issues it with csrf_theme added, but the test replayed the older /_session cookie holding only uid, so checkCSRFKey saw an empty want and correctly refused. Fixed by posting with the cookie /settings returned, which is what a browser sends. Production path unchanged.

The fix is also diagnostic: it now fails loudly if /settings does NOT re-issue the session cookie, which is what a genuine sess.Save() failure would look like. Re-run pending — the assistant never runs the suite.
